name: Hat ToF
summary: Returns distance to a target using a VL53L0X time-of-flight sensor.

interface.range_note: Up to 2 m is conditional; vendor notes about 1.2 m in normal mode and 2 m in long-range/dark conditions.

host_bindings.notes: Vendor bench report gives SDA8/SCL0 at 100 kHz; see vendor_bench_report.candidate_connection. This has not been physically verified by the plugin and must not be applied to an unknown revision. Confirm seating/orientation and 3.3V. Do not copy legacy StickC SDA0/SCL26 or Grove GPIO9/10. GPIO0 is a boot-strapping signal: check cold boot with the HAT attached and do not force it low during reset.

support.meaning: Primary-source review plus separately labeled vendor bench notes. No accessory driver or emulator input is implemented; vendor results are not plugin physical acceptance.

first_hardware_check: Compare the attached HAT against the vendor SDA8/SCL0 candidate and manufacturer connector drawings; use 3.3V and start at 100 kHz. Detect 0x29 and initialize with a bounded timeout.
Try a flat target at known distances, then remove it. Show millimetres and validity; check cold boot with the HAT attached.
Discard invalid/out-of-range samples before optional 3-5-sample smoothing. A timeout must remain unavailable, not be averaged into a false distance.
troubleshooting: A timeout or out-of-range status is not zero distance.
Do not confuse the U072 HAT with a Grove ToF Unit or VL53L1X revision.
If combining two 0x29 sensors, plan reset/address reassignment or a suitable multiplexer; address collision is not fixed by parallel wiring.

app_fixture_plan.note: App-owned millimetre fixtures can test UI logic, not optics, measurement accuracy or sensor timing.

libraries.name: VL53L0X Arduino driver
libraries.author: Pololu
libraries.purpose: Driver linked by M5Stack HAT example; verify selected revision/license before reuse.

vendor_bench_report.scope: Reported observations from a separate vendor build; not plugin driver or physical acceptance.
notes: The vendor used StickS3 top HAT SDA GPIO8 and SCL GPIO0 at 100 kHz, separate from Grove GPIO9/10.
Confirm exact HAT seating, connector orientation and supply before using this route; the plugin has not repeated the physical test.
The vendor found roughly 30-120 cm useful for its demo. This is a bench observation, not a guaranteed minimum or maximum range.
